title: ShiftChangeHandoverLog
description: Atomic handover document written by a draining Claude session for consumption by the successor session

handoffId.description: Unique identifier for this handoff event (UUID v4 recommended)

generation.description: Monotonically increasing generation counter for this objective

status.description: Lifecycle state of this handover log

sessionId.description: Unique identifier for the session that wrote this log

activePid.description: Process ID of the session that wrote this log (informational only — best-effort, may be stale)

currentObjective.description: High-level goal still in progress at time of handoff

contextPercent.description: Estimated context window utilization at time of handoff (0.0–1.0)

contextSummary.description: Oral tradition capture — implicit context, conventions, and decisions not in memory files

memoryPointers.description: References to recent updates in persistent memory files

pendingActions.description: Tasks the successor session must execute upon claiming

subagentStates.description: State snapshot of active or recently completed subagents

resumeInstructions.description: Imperative instructions for what the successor session must do first

pendingMemoryWrites.description: Memory write operations that were pending at drain time and must be applied by successor

drainDeadline.description: ISO8601 deadline after which drain is declared complete regardless of active tasks

timestamp.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this log was written
